report_clean.jpg.notes: Clearest of the set — baseline case for OCR accuracy comparison.

report_angled.jpg.notes: Skewed/rotated photo of the same or similar report. Tests OCR robustness to non-straight capture angle.

report_lowlight.jpg.notes: Poor lighting/shadow. Tests OCR robustness to degraded image quality. Contains a partial doctor-name fragment in one corner, otherwise redacted.

report_cropped.jpg.notes: Header intentionally cropped out during PII redaction. Tests graceful handling of a report with missing/partial header metadata.

report_complex.jpg.notes: Dense multi-section layout (CBC + differential + blood group + chemistry all on one page). Stress test for parsing a busier table structure.

not_a_lab_report.jpg.notes: An ULTA Beauty store receipt — not a medical document at all. Tests that the service degrades gracefully (returns empty/low-confidence results) rather than fabricating fake lab data from unrelated content.
